title: Finite locally free sheaves with rank allowed to vary
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The sheaf $\mathcal F$ is finite locally free if there is an open cover $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ of $X$ and, for each $i$, a finite integer $r_i\geq 0$ with $\mathcal F|_{U_i}\cong\mathcal O_{U_i}^{\oplus r_i}$. The integers $r_i$ may vary with $i$.
